title: Talkora Curriculum Intelligence Schema (Sprint 1, revised)
description: Machine-readable contract for Talkora curriculum datasets across BOTH official Maharashtra Std 1 English textbooks (dual-track decision, PM checkpoint 1): English Balbharati Grade One (English-medium track) and My English Book Grade One (non-English-medium track). TypeScript-compatible: every object maps 1:1 to an interface in handoff-to-codex.md. REVISION 1.1.0 decisions (PM, 2026-10-31): explicit textbook discriminator; curriculum-version metadata preserved; syllabus-verification and pedagogy-review statuses kept distinct; DRAFT_PENDING_TEACHER_REVIEW is the mandatory initial pedagogy status; audioAsset optional; namespaced curriculum entry IDs (bal-/meb-) requiring no database migration because IDs are only consumed by new additive lookups; chapter-to-level mapping remains PROPOSED_MAPPING_PENDING_PM_APPROVAL. Schema changes must be coordinated with the Project Manager before contracts are finalized.

textbookTrack.description: PM decision: Talkora supports BOTH official Std 1 English textbooks as separately identified curriculum tracks. School/admin configuration selects the applicable textbook; students never choose their curriculum or difficulty.

textbookId.description: Stable discriminator. Existing canonical level IDs (g01-l01 …) and the existing English Balbharati implementation are unchanged; textbookId namespaces datasets, never runtime level IDs.

selectionModel.description: Must state that school/admin configuration selects the track and students do not choose curriculum or difficulty.

curriculumVersion.description: Curriculum-framework metadata preserved alongside the textbook edition so edition drift and framework drift are independently detectable.

verificationAuthority.description: e.g. 'SCERT Maharashtra, Pune-30 (stated on the book's title page)'

approval.description: Approval statement as printed in the book (committee, date, academic year of first use).

locator.description: Precise locator, e.g. 'My English Book Grade One (2025), printed p.5, chapter 1.5'.

audioAsset.description: OPTIONAL per PM checkpoint 1. The official books carry QR audio, but rights are undecided; datasets must never claim an audio asset exists.

status.description: MISSING or RIGHTS_UNDECIDED until Balbharati authorization is documented; APPROVED requires a permission reference.

officialQrRef.description: Locator of the in-book QR code the asset would complement.

curriculumId.description: Namespaced stable address (no database migration required: IDs are additive and no existing ID is reused or changed). Prefix encodes the textbook: bal- = English Balbharati; meb- = My English Book. Suffix derivation unchanged: printed unit.chapter code N.M maps to c<N>.<pad(M,2)> (printed 1.1 → c1.01; printed 1.11 → c1.11). Chapter codes are unique WITHIN a textbook only — cross-textbook disambiguation is via the textbookId discriminator and the ID prefix.

textbookId.description: Required per-entry discriminator; must match dataset.textbookTrack.textbookId and the curriculumId prefix (bal ↔ ENGLISH_BALBHARATI_G01, meb ↔ MY_ENGLISH_BOOK_G01_NON_ENGLISH_MEDIUM).

title.description: Only if the book prints a unit title; otherwise null. Never invented.

code.description: Chapter number exactly as printed in the Contents (1.1 … 1.10 for English Balbharati Unit One; 1.1 … 1.11 for My English Book Unit One). Per-track bounds are enforced by the validator.

title.description: Chapter title exactly as printed in the Contents.

contentCategory.description: PICTURE_TALK / PHONICS_SOUNDS / GREETINGS_DIALOGUE / ABILITY_GAME / PICTURE_STORY added in v1.1.0 for My English Book's oral-first chapter types; original values unchanged.

category.description: THIRD_PARTY_PERMISSION_AWAITED added in v1.1.0: the official contents page of both 2025 books states 'Some permission are awaited. Acknowledgement to them will be made in subsequent reprint.'

reproductionRule.description: How Talkora may use this chapter: reference-only, title-only, or short attributed excerpt.

talkoraLevelId.description: Canonical level address from backend/src/curriculum/level-map-contract.ts. UNCHANGED by the dual-track decision; both tracks map onto the same ten canonical levels.

roadmapTitle.description: Exact title from roadmap.ts, echoed for drift detection.

role.description: Added in v1.1.0 for the ordered coverage matrix: a chapter may introduce an objective early (oral/TPR) and a later level consolidates it, so no objective appears only at a late level and no level is skipped.

hi.description: Hindi support gloss (Devanagari), written by Talkora — not from the textbook. Terminology discipline (PM correction): school = Hindi विद्यालय/पाठशाला; शाळा is Marathi ONLY.

mr.description: Marathi support gloss (Devanagari), written by Talkora — not from the textbook.

sourceRef.description: e.g. '1.1 Look and say, printed p.1'.

childFriendlyFraming.description: Child-appropriate AND accurate. Articles rule (PM correction): 'an' goes before vowel SOUNDS (not letters) — an elephant, an egg; 'a' before consonant sounds — a box; 'the' for the one we all know — the sun, the sky. No written-language exceptions at Grade 1.

assetStatus.description: Mirrors KG visualAssets.status convention; never claims an asset exists.

recallDesign.description: Added in v1.1.0 (PM correction): every entry must distinguish three memory milestones — IMMEDIATE_REPETITION (child repeats right after Miss Julie), INDEPENDENT_ANSWERING (child answers a fresh prompt in the same session with no model), DELAYED_RECALL (child produces the language in a later session, e.g. next day or at home). A child who only repeats has met the first milestone only; mastery indicators below must not be satisfiable by repetition alone.

adaptiveTeachingHints.description: Difficulty is adaptive only — students never pick a level; these hints drive Miss Julie's branch selection.

masteryIndicators.description: Independent-use checks; a correct first answer alone never declares mastery. Must be satisfiable only at the INDEPENDENT_ANSWERING or DELAYED_RECALL milestone, never by IMMEDIATE_REPETITION.

teachingStages.description: Subset of the 8 stages actually used by this chapter; stages are a design language, not a mandatory repeat.

review.description: The two review axes stay distinct (PM decision): syllabus verification is about source fidelity, pedagogy status is about a human teacher's sign-off. Synthetic example validation NEVER counts as teacher approval.

pedagogyStatus.description: DRAFT_PENDING_TEACHER_REVIEW is the mandatory initial state; the validator fails any entry claiming teacher approval.

exampleId.description: Globally unique across both tracks (single example bank; textbookId on each record disambiguates).

chapterRef.description: Chapter code within the record's own textbook.

ttsNote.description: Optional voice-routing note (Azure/Qwen), no runtime behaviour implied.

masteryCheck.description: How Miss Julie later verifies independent use instead of declaring mastery immediately. Must reference INDEPENDENT_ANSWERING or DELAYED_RECALL, never repetition alone.

correctionStrategy.description: Miss Julie's corrective move; gentle, never shaming. Language attribution must be correct (शाळा is Marathi; Hindi for school is विद्यालय/पाठशाला/स्कूल).
